text:
josh-sales: Heads-up 12h AuroraMed POC overnight run flagged huge tail at sustained 500 qps. p50 ~120ms, p95 ~280ms, but p99 spikes to ~2.9s. Need triage + a short customer note. Anyone available?

eli: I'm on it. Can you share the exact workload and runtime config? Also did you pin model version or allow auto-fallback?

josh-sales: Run harness: `wrk -t12 -c420 -d10m --script=post.lua https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate` targets file includes a mix of 30/60/200-token prompts to mimic clinical notes. Runtime: `redwood/gpt-medium-quant`, max_seq=768, batching target=6, kv_cache=on, warmup 15m. Header: `X-Project: auroramed-poc`.

tara: Infra note: we saw occasional GC pauses on the inference hosts around midnight (avg 60-90ms pauses on a subset). Logging shows one node had 30% IO wait during the window.

devops: Can you re-run a short isolate: (A) kv_cache=off (B) batching=2 (C) model=`redwood/gpt-medium-int8` so we can compare kernel paths. I'll put a temporary node taint on any noisy hosts.

ops-bot: Canary deploy event: runtime-v2.4.0 rolled at 2026-04-02T00:30Z in canary pool. No config changes.

eli: Plan / checklist: 1) reproduce short 5m runs at 500 qps with the three toggles; 2) collect per-request timing (queue, compute, network); 3) pull KV hit rate + avg batch size + GPU util; 4) capture host-level io/steal.

josh-sales: Also note AuroraMed asked whether any encrypted PHI touched our logs during the POC. Short answer: we redacted payloads server-side and stored MD5 hashes only; no KMS wrapping of inference payloads.

tara: I'll add that to the security questionnaire answer doc. They also asked for a list of allowed IPs for egress to their VPC 13. That's an enterprise gating item for the next phase.

eli: Running quick toggles now. Posting preliminary numbers (5m runs @500 qps):
- baseline (kv=ON, batching=6, model=quant): p50 118ms, p95 281ms, p99 2900ms, kv_hit=61%, avg_batch=6.1, gpu_util=62%
- kv=OFF (batching=6): p50 130ms, p95 260ms, p99 1400ms, kv_hit=0%, avg_batch=6.0, gpu_util=64%
- batching=2 (kv=OFF): p50 140ms, p95 310ms, p99 520ms, avg_batch=1.9, gpu_util=47%
- model=int8 variant (kv=OFF, batching=6): p50 105ms, p95 240ms, p99 980ms, avg_batch=5.8, gpu_util=70%

eli: Observations: 1) KV prefix caching correlated with very long tail on some requests 14, likely due to occasional cache-miss work and cache rehydration path blocking. 2) Host IO/GC noise amplified p99 (matches tara infra notes). 3) Lowering batch reduces tail but increases cost. int8 improves p50 and trims tail vs quant in this workload.

devops: After tainting noisy hosts and re-running baseline, baseline p99 trimmed to ~1.2s (was 2.9s). So host contention was a major amplifier.

josh-sales: Great. Can you give a short pricing delta table for sales to include? Aurora needs ballpark for three configs: safety-first (low tail), balanced, throughput-max.

eli: Rough cost multipliers vs baseline (aggressive batching=6, kv=ON) token-cost baseline = 1.0:
- safety-first (batch=2, kv=OFF, int8): cost ~2.1x; p95 ~300ms, p99 ~520ms
- balanced (batch=4, kv=ON, int8): cost ~1.35x; p95 ~210-260ms, p99 ~850-1.0s
- throughput-max (batch=6, kv=ON, quant): cost ~1.0x; p95 ~280ms, p99 ~1.2-1.4s on stable infra

tara: Note for legal/security: AuroraMed's security team flagged SOC2+HIPAA and wants KMS envelope wrapping for logs before prod. That will add minor latency (few ms) but no large tail. Also they requested a diagram of data flow 15.

josh-sales: Can we produce a one-pager summary and an ETA? Aurora wants a short write-up + CSV of run metrics for the tech review tomorrow.

eli: I'll own the write-up + CSV. ETA within 18 hours with charts (p50/p95/p99 across toggles) and recommended prod config: `redwood/gpt-medium-int8`, batching=4, kv_cache=on with pre-warm policy + auto-fallback to batch=2 when p95>300ms.

devops: I'll finalize infra sweep and provide an ops checklist to avoid noisy-host amplification (taint/upscale rule + scheduled GC windows).

tara: I'll update security answers (KMS notes, PHI handling, IP allowlist steps) and send draft to @josh-sales for signoff.

josh-sales: Thanks all. Owners: eli -> perf write-up & CSV, devops -> infra checklist, tara -> security Q&A. Closing after write-up posted. :thumbsup:
